name: @tedix/desktop
description: Tedix desktop shell: the Tedix OS chat in a window, with this computer's runner status and switches from the Tedix CLI.

scripts.compile: bun build src/main.ts src/preload.ts --outdir out --target node --format cjs --external electron --entry-naming '[name].cjs' && bun build src/panel.ts src/strip.ts --outdir out --target browser
scripts.dev: bun run compile && node node_modules/electron/install.js && electron .
